# HandPose

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Runtime/Scripts/Interaction/HandPose.cs#L47)

A hand shape, stored as local bone rotations and matched onto a hand mesh by bone name.

Bone names rather than indices, because that is already how [`HandVisualSolver`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/HandVisualSolver)
pairs the tracked hand to the mesh, so a pose captured on one hand applies to any hand built
on the same skeleton, and a rig that gains or loses a bone degrades to leaving that bone alone
instead of writing a rotation onto the wrong joint.

The asset carries a [`version`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/HandPose#version) from the first one saved. Auto Hand, which stores
the same kind of data, changed its layout in place and now ships a deprecation check on every
container plus a wizard to walk a project through the upgrade. A number costs nothing now and
is the difference between migrating and guessing later.
